The '''Olabria system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Olabrian trichoid]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]].<ref name="TTaBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Olabria system was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TTaBS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system within grid square J-20.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
